Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid

  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(gi, tgtmap={'tl':'bl','tr':'tl','bl':'br','br':'tr'}):
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    bl=blocks(gi)
    marks=[(rr,cc,gi[rr][cc]) for rr in range(len(gi)) for cc in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[rr][cc] not in (0,2)]
    def corner(bb,nm): return {'tl':(bb[0],bb[1]),'tr':(bb[0],bb[3]),'bl':(bb[2],bb[1]),'br':(bb[2],bb[3])}[nm]

        for nm,ptn in tgtmap.items():
            hc,hr=corner(bb,ptn); dr,dc=DIRS[nm]
            col=min(marks,key=lambda m:(abs(m[0]-hr)+abs(m[1]-hc),m[0],m[1]))[2]

            while 0<=r<len(gi) and 0<=c<len(gi[0]):

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
DIRS={'tl':(-1,-1),'tr':(-1,1),'br':(1,1),'bl':(1,-1)}
CS=['tl','tr','br','bl']
# clockwise corner order around block center: TL, BL, BR, TR -> dirs (-1,-1),(1,-1),(1,1),(-1,1)
CW=[(-1,-1),(1,-1),(1,1),(-1,1)]
def solve(gi,raystop_nonzero=True,ccw_rec=False):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    bl=[]
    for r0 in range(H-1):
        for c0 in range(W-1):
            if all(gi[r0+i][c0+j]==2 for i in (0,1) for j in (0,1)):
                bl.append((r0,c0))
    res=None
    for br0,bc0 in bl:
        seq=[(br0+dr,bc0+dc) for dr,dc in CW]          # marker positions cw around block
        cols=[gi[r][c] for r,c in seq]
        nc=[cols[-1:][0]] if False else ([cols[0]]+[c for c in cols[1:]] ) 
        # recolor: each marker gets color of prev marker in CW order (i.e. rotate colors forward by one, assigned to pos in same order)
        if ccw_rec: nc=[cols[(k_+1)%4] for k_ in range(4)]  # assign to seq[k_] using next-in-cw color
        else:       nc=[cols[(k_-1)%4] for k_ in range(4)]
        for k_,(pos,col) in enumerate(zip(seq,nc)):
            out[pos[0]][pos[1]]=col
            dr,dc=CW[k_]
            r,c=pos[0]+dr,pos[1]+dc
            while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and (out[r][c]==0 or out[r][c]==2):
                if outstop := None: pass
                if out[r][c]!=0 and out[r][c]!=2 and raystop_nonzero: break
                out[r][c]=col; r+=dr; c+=dc
    return out
for ccw in [False,True]:
    tot=0
    for k in [1,2,3,4]:
        gi=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
        res=solve(gi,ccw_rec=ccw)
        b=sum(1 for rr in range(len(go)) for cc in range(len(go[0])) if res[rr][cc]!=go[rr][cc])
        tot+=b
        print('ccw-rec' if ccw else 'cw-rec','demo',k,'bad:',b)
    print('total',ccw,tot)

import os,re,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def blocks(g): return [(r0,c0) for r0 in range(len(g)-1) for c0 in range(len(g[0])-1) if all(x==2 for x in g[r0:r0+2][c0:c0+2])]
def solve(sr,g):
    out=[row[:] for row in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bs=blocks(g)
    for (r0,c0) in bs:
        cm={cn:g[MARKERPOS[cn](r0,c0)[0]][MARKERPOS[cn](r0,c0)[1]] for cn in ('tl','tr','br','bl')}
        for cn in ('tl','tr','br','bl'): cm[cn]=cm[sr[cn]]
        for cn,(mr,mc) in [('tl',(r0-1,c0-1)),('tr',(r0-1,c0+2)),('br',(r0+2,c0+1)),('bl',(r0+1,c0))]:
            col=cm[cn]
            if col==0: continue
            dr,dc=D[cn]
            r,c=mr+dr,mc+dc
            while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W:
                v=out[r][c]
                if v!=0: break
                out[r][c]=col; r+=dr; c+=dc
    return out

        ok.append((o==e,len(bad)))
    print(name,ok)

    return G

G=load()
DIRS={'tl':(-1,-1),'tr':(-1,1),'br':(1,1),'bl':(1,-1)}
PP={'tl':lambda r0,c0:(r0-1,c0-1),'tr':lambda r0,c0:(r0-1,c0+2),
    'br':lambda r0,c0:(r0+2,c0+2),'bl':lambda r0,c0:(r0+2,c0-1)}
def solve(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bs=blocks_of(g); order=['tl','tr','br','bl']
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    info=[]
    for bi,(r0,c0) in enumerate(bs):
        slots={cn:PP[cn](r0,c0) for cn in order}
        colsn=[g[slots[cn][0]][slots[cn][1]] if (0<=slots[cn][0]<H and 0<=slots[cn][1]<W and g[slots[cn][0]][slots[cn][1]] not in (0,2)) else None for cn in order]
        # recolor each marker with color of CW-next marker (cycle +1)
        newcols=[colsn[(i+1)%4] for i in range(4)]
        for oi,(pos,col,newcol) in enumerate(zip(slots.values(),colsn,newcols)):
            pos=pos
            info.append((pos,newcol))
    # paint rays from recolored markers along diagonal outward; stop at non-background other than own ray start, no block stop needed
    for pos,newcol in info:
        # determine role by sign: use block-local list instead; recompute roles here via slots lookup per block - redo cleanly below
        pass
    return out
# clean rewrite:
def solve_clean(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bs=blocks_of(g); order=['tl','tr','br','bl']
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for bi,(r0,c0) in enumerate(bs):
        slots=[(cn,PP[cn](r0,c0)) for cn in order]
        cols={}
        for cn,pos in slots:
            pr,pc=pos
            if 0<=pr<H and 0<=pc<W and g[pr][pc] not in (0,2):
                cols[cn]=g[pr][pc]
        # recolor: each marker takes the color of the NEXT marker in CW order (cycle)
        newcols={}
        for i,cn in enumerate(order):
            tgt=order[(i+1)%4]
            nc=cols.get(tgt, cols.get(cn))   # fallback keep own if target absent
            newcols[cn]=nc
        # paint ray from each marker cell along its outward diagonal, using its NEW color; stop at any non-background or block
        for cn,pos in slots:
            mr,mc=pos
            dr,dc=DIRS[cn]
            r,c=mr+dr,mc+dc
            while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W:
                v=out[r][c]
                if v==2: break
                if v!=0 and v!=newcols[cn]: break
                out[r][c]=newcols[cn]
                r+=dr; c+=dc
    return out
res=[solve_clean(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {i} output'] for i in (1,2,3,4)]
print(res)

def solve(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bs=blocks_of(g); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for (r0,c0) in bs:
        slots=[(cn,PP[cn](r0,c0)) for cn in order]
        cols={cn:g[pos[0]][pos[1]] for cn,pos in slots if 0<=pos[0]<H and 0<=pos[1]<W and g[pos[0]][pos[1]]!=2}
        newcols={cn:cols[order[(order.index(cn)-1)%4]] for cn in order}   # each marker takes prev-in-cycle (CCW predecessor) color
        for cn,pos in slots:
            mr,mc=pos
            dr,dc=DIRS[cn]
            r,c=mr+dr,mc+dc
            while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W:
                v=out[r][c]
                if v==2: break
                if v!=0 and v!=newcols[cn]: break
                out[r][c]=newcols[cn]
                r+=dr; c+=dc
    return out
